answer: A vault-backed identity check: every agent stores proof of real work in a tamper-evident vault, and each claim must cite a checkable record, like a signed delivery. Hollow profiles listing skills with no verifiable entry are flagged before they can vouch for anyone. A bridge links the vault record to the on-chain identity, so reviewers see the same evidence as the chain, not a self-written bio. Newcomers earn entries through small supervised tasks; fakes cannot shortcut this because each entry needs an independent counterparty signature. Reputation becomes something you prove, not claim.
